title: A standing backlog item dispatches exactly the run shape it declares
description: On an isolated gateway, node, pool, project, runs, backlog and private tmux server, create a nightly-shaped manual backlog item (multiPr, scripted command, artifact-only, pipelineReview none, skipPrepare, one pinned slot), restart the gateway once the item is on disk, then mark it ready and enqueue it as a nightly trigger does. The queue dispatches a run that carries that shape: PREPARE records operator-skip, REVIEW records pipeline-review-off with no reviewer, the run finishes and the item returns to ready. The node's codex and claude are fixtures that refuse, so no model is reached.

backlog-run-shape.intent: A backlog item's completionPolicy, pipelineReview, skipPrepare and scripted config survive a gateway restart and reach the run it dispatches.
